Proposition
[universal noncollapsing of ancient three-dimensional solutions] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 6.4.2\group Three-Dimensional Ancient Kappa-Solutions There exists a positive constant $\kappa _0$ with the following property. Suppose we have a nonflat three-dimensional ancient $\kappa $-solution for some $\kappa >0$. Then either the solution is $\kappa _0$-noncollapsed on all scales, or it is a metric quotient of the round three-sphere.
Proof

The spherical alternative makes the original flow round; in the cylindrical case, the reduced-volume argument supplies a universal local volume lower bound, hence $\kappa _0$ \cite{P2}.
